topic: the datastore for the order-tracking service

chain.speaker: Arjun
chain.gist: Arjun proposes using MongoDB for the order-tracking service.

chain.speaker: Arjun
chain.gist: Arjun says the schema will keep changing for months and documents avoid a migration per change.

chain.speaker: Meera
chain.gist: Meera agrees to go ahead with the MongoDB plan.

chain.speaker: Wei
chain.gist: Wei reports a weekend load test: at about two million orders the daily report aggregation takes 38 seconds and is still climbing.

chain.speaker: Lena
chain.gist: Lena argues reporting is join-heavy and finance needs consistent transactions across orders and payments, so it gets worse as data grows.

chain.speaker: Meera
chain.gist: Meera says the load test and finance's transaction requirement mean they must reopen the datastore decision.

chain.speaker: Lena
chain.gist: Lena argues PostgreSQL with JSONB keeps the flexible fields while adding joins and transactions, and switching now costs about a week.

chain.speaker: Meera
chain.gist: Meera decides to switch the order-tracking service to PostgreSQL; Arjun redoes the schema, Lena reviews.

questions.question: Why was the original decision about the datastore for the order-tracking service changed?
questions.answer_text: Original: MongoDB (document database), because Arjun says the schema will keep changing for months and documents avoid a migration per change. Triggered by: Wei (evidence): Wei reports a weekend load test: at about two million orders the daily report aggregation takes 38 seconds and is still climbing. Lena (challenge): Lena argues reporting is join-heavy and finance needs consistent transactions across orders and payments, so it gets worse as data grows. Meera (reconsideration): Meera says the load test and finance's transaction requirement mean they must reopen the datastore decision. New choice: PostgreSQL with JSONB columns, because Lena argues PostgreSQL with JSONB keeps the flexible fields while adding joins and transactions, and switching now costs about a week.
